units.source_text: 例如早晨吃一剂，不吃午餐也不觉得饿。

en.t: For example, if you take one dose in the morning, you do not feel hungry even if you skip lunch.

units.source_text: 这么说，它好像是具有魔法的药了，

en.t: Put that way, it sounds as if this medicine has magical powers,

units.source_text: 其实不是肚子不饿，而是下腹有力，精力旺盛，

en.t: but in fact it is not that the stomach is not hungry; rather, the lower abdomen feels strong and the whole body is full of energy,

units.source_text: 所以从事繁忙事务的人，常常疏忽地忘记吃中饭的时间，

en.t: so people engaged in busy work often absentmindedly forget that it is time for lunch,
and their bodies do not feel tired either.

units.source_text: 包括原满铁总裁山本条太郎阁下在内的朝野名士三万余人，

en.t: More than thirty thousand prominent figures from government and society, including His Excellency Yamamoto Jotaro, former president of the South Manchuria Railway,

units.source_text: 超越政党派别，都成了本会的顾问，

en.t: have crossed party and factional lines and all become advisers to this association,

units.source_text: 他们称赞松之绿的伟大力量。

en.t: and they praise the great power of Matsunomidori.

units.source_text: 从前叫作百病，今天有一千八百多种病……

en.t: What used to be called the hundred illnesses has today become more than eighteen hundred kinds of disease...

units.source_text: 其中松之绿不能治好的只有两种。

en.t: Among them, there are only two that Matsunomidori cannot cure.

units.source_text: 一种是嗜睡性脑脊髓膜炎，一种是麻风病。

en.t: One is lethargic meningoencephalitis, and the other is leprosy.

units.source_text: 除了这两种以外，不论任何重症，只要连续服用一周，就会立即见效。

en.t: Apart from these two, no matter how serious the illness, if you take it continuously for one week, it will show results at once.
